project.name: aquarium
project.productType: desktop app (Electron) for internal P2P screen sharing in small groups, Discord-like rooms

typography.body: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, system-ui

preferredPrimitives: plain React + CSS (no Tailwind, no component library yet)

must: works offline from bundled assets (Electron, strict CSP: no remote fonts or scripts)
any room member can start/stop streaming and watch any stream
avoid: Discord logo, name, mascots or exact brand colors

decisions.decision: Direction B 'Palco' (stage-first): video fills the window; room switcher in the top bar; floating room rail on the left; bottom dock with Transmitir, Som, Qualidade, Layout, Configurações, Sair
decisions.why: small, closed group that keeps using Discord for voice; the app is mostly for watching
also: right-click on a stream opens audio options: per-stream volume/mute for viewers; audio source (only the shared app / all apps / none) for your own stream
Discord and Aquarium are never captured in stream audio (avoid echo/feedback)
settings dialog from the dock: quality defaults, bandwidth cap (auto by default), blocked apps, audio defaults, output device
